purpose: Implementation acceptance scenarios, not existing executable tests or completed test results.
lane_note: Lanes are test categories, not alternate language dialects. upstream_reference and host_bootstrap are external builds, not S-Go target modes. Production/lab retain identical safety/admission rules. Shared model/typed/native cases must be instantiated per required implementation phase.
